title: The Far Compass
author: Ivo Iversen
blurb: Ansel Vasquez, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
